title: FileList
description: What `ls -o json` prints: every entry of every listing, in the order they were listed. `ls -o yaml` is the same document.

entry.description: One file. The fields after `type` are present when the file could be examined; `error` when it could not.

name.description: The name as listed: the operand as given, or the directory entry's name. Non-UTF-8 bytes are shown as U+FFFD.

path.description: The path used to reach the file.

dir.description: The directory the entry was listed in; empty for an operand.

perm.description: The permission and set-id bits in octal.

owner.description: The login name, or the uid as text when unknown or with -n.

flags.description: chflags(1) names, comma-separated; empty when none.

atime.description: RFC 3339 with nanoseconds, in the zone TZ names.

target.description: Symbolic links only: what the link holds, unresolved.

error.description: Why the file could not be examined.
